command:
set -euo pipefail; BASE=/workspace/frankgrid10-organ; SRC=/workspace/.frankgrid10-daemon-upgrade; test -z "$(find "$BASE/ipc/processing" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.json' -print -quit)"; test -z "$(find "$BASE/ipc/inbox" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.json' -print -quit)"; rm -rf "$SRC"; ORIGIN=$(git -C /workspace/clay-global-research-entity remote get-url origin); git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-frankgrid10-sandbox "$ORIGIN" "$SRC"; cp "$SRC/research_entity/experiments/chatgpt_frankgrid10/organ_daemon.py" "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py.new"; rm -rf "$SRC"; python3 -m py_compile "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py.new"; NEWSHA=$(sha256sum "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py.new"|awk '{print $1}'); OLD=$(cat "$BASE/run/organ-daemon.pid"); kill -0 "$OLD"; tr '\0' ' ' <"/proc/$OLD/cmdline" | grep -Fq '/workspace/frankgrid10-organ/code/organ_daemon.py'; kill -TERM "$OLD"; for i in $(seq 1 30); do if ! kill -0 "$OLD" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep .2; done; if kill -0 "$OLD" 2>/dev/null; then echo OLD_DAEMON_DID_NOT_EXIT >&2; exit 71; fi; mv "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py.new" "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py"; : > "$BASE/logs/organ-daemon.log"; nohup setsid python3 "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py" --poll 0.5 >>"$BASE/logs/organ-daemon.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & PID=$!; echo "$PID" > "$BASE/run/organ-daemon.pid"; sleep 3; kill -0 "$PID"; echo DAEMON_SOURCE_SHA256=$NEWSHA; echo OLD_PID=$OLD; echo NEW_PID=$PID; cat "$BASE/run/heartbeat.json"; echo IDENTITY; cat "$BASE/identity/identity.json"; echo CURRENT_EPOCH; cat "$BASE/identity/current_epoch.json"; python3 - "$BASE/state/frankgrid10.sqlite3" <<'PY'
import sqlite3,sys
c=sqlite3.connect(sys.argv[1]); print('DB_INTEGRITY',c.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0])
PY
echo FRANKGRID10_IDENTITY_RESOURCE_UPGRADE_PASS
